fieldNotes.location: Roster coords (45.975374,-94.865992) landed at the SE corner of the property near the river; the plant complex sits NW of that point. Locked center 45.97720,-94.86780 on the main plant building. Confirmed via Hormel careers page and the 20 Riverside Dr address.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Open site. StreetView (2014) shows the access road running straight into the complex with no barrier arm, no gate across the truck drive, and no perimeter fence. A tractor-trailer is parked in the open yard directly off the public road. truckGate false.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth anywhere along the entry road or yard.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Sprawling campus of ~5 separate large buildings (main processing plant, attached gray building, a separate gray-roofed dock building, plus support warehouses) -> multipleFacilities true.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Large open trailer-storage areas with 40+ trailers parked across the campus, separate from the active dock apron -> dropYard true.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: ~22 dock doors counted, primarily on the SW face of the lower gray-roofed building plus the main plant; banded 10-25, low-confidence due to scattered building faces.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 25-50 untethered trailers parked in the open lots.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Long Prairie MN is a small rural town (~3,400 pop); the plant sits at the edge of town beside the Long Prairie River and farmland -> Rural.
fieldNotes.truckGateCount: No controlled gate; the count of 1 reflects the single open access point off the public road.
